name: adidas Yeezy Foam Runner 'MX Cinder'
story_html: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner ‘MX Cinder’ enlivens the slip-on silhouette with cooling splashes of color. Built with injected EVA foam, the one-piece upper is rendered in an earthy mix of brown and tan shades. Atop the vamp, a solid black finish is contrasted by unexpected bursts of aqua blue. A series of strategically mapped vents provide enhanced breathability, while the soft top layer of the footbed delivers step-in comfort. Underfoot, the contoured outsole features a wavy tread for optimal grip.
